configurations.title: Cascading Curation
configurations.study_desc:
Level one curation at Horizon includes identification of the plant by an observer in the field using 

 7623  - plant that the organism was found on 

A curator will then use this table to fill in
 21998 - location on plant (leaf, flower, stem, etc.) 
 21273 - plant interaction (nectaring / pollinating, feeding, etc.)
configurations.field_name: plant that the organism was found on

configurations.study_desc:
Level two curation at Horizon displays any organism curated as having been found on a flower during level one.  This table allows further curation of these observations for pollination and nectaring via 

 9603  - proboscis inserted (does the photo show the proboscis being inserted?) 
 11472 - body combing pollen (does the photo show body combing pollen attached?)
